4 24-02-2026 Heard learned counsel for the parties.
2. Petitioners apprehend arrest in a case registered for the offence punishable under sections 341,
323, 379, 498A/34 of the IPC and sections 3 & 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act.
3.
As per FIR, petitioners demanded dowry and on non payment of the same, they tortured opposite party no.2 and ousted her from the matrimonial house.
Thereafter, she lodged a complaint in which petitioners were granted bail in light of compromise arrived at between the parties and as per terms of compromise, she went to the matrimonial house.
Again, petitioners ousted opposite party no.2 and her child from the house leading to filing of this case.
4. Learned counsel appearing for the petitioners submits that allegation of assault is general, vague and sweeping.
Petitioner no.1 is husband of opposite party no.2, Patna High Court CR.

MISC.
No.19158 of 2025(4) dt.24-02-2026 whereas petitioner no.2 is her father-in-law.

As a matter of fact,
opposite party no.2 herself left the house as she does not want to live with her husband since he is a disabled person.
Petitioners are ready to keep her in the matrimonial house with dignity and safety.
